history_note: T0030 through T0036 are PRESERVED unchanged. Migrations 0011 through 0015 are preserved; 0016 and 0017 correct and extend them additively.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: 0015 permitted CREATED to move directly to a terminal status. Section 16 defines exactly one edge out of CREATED, and a runtime that can terminate a charge without ever having begun executing it can record a financial outcome for a request that was never made.
corrections.correction: 0016 narrows the machine to CREATED -> PENDING -> CAPTURED|FAILED|EXPIRED|CANCELLED|UNKNOWN. Every direct CREATED-to-terminal edge now raises PAYMENT_STATUS_TRANSITION.
corrections.proved: iam_v2_scratch/phase4_0011_financial.sh drives each of CAPTURED, FAILED, CANCELLED, EXPIRED and UNKNOWN against a genuinely CREATED row and shows the refusal, then shows CREATED -> PENDING still permitted so the machine is narrow rather than broken.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: Payment intent creation and Settlement admission were incoherent: a Settlement already SETTLED, FAILED, PARTIALLY_REVERSED or REVERSED would still admit a new CHARGE. That charge could later be captured while the settlement stayed terminal, leaving captured money whose settlement says otherwise.
corrections.correction: 0016 adds the p4_payment_admission_gate BEFORE INSERT trigger, which locks the settlement row and refuses a CHARGE against a terminal settlement with PAYMENT_SETTLEMENT_CLOSED.
corrections.proved: Go integration TestIntegrationPayment_DeclinedChargeFailsTheSettlementAndGrantsNothing (a FAILED settlement refuses a second charge) and TestIntegrationPayment_UnknownGoesToManualReviewAndIsNeverRetried (a live UNKNOWN charge blocks another).

corrections.what_was_actually_true: apply_payment_callback_v2 invented IN_PROGRESS for itself when a callback arrived, so the settlement only learned it was executing AFTER the provider had already been contacted. That is the crash window in which a provider can take money while StayConnect has no durable record of having asked.
corrections.correction: 0016 adds iam_v2.begin_payment_execution(uuid): in ONE transaction it moves the Settlement REQUIRED -> IN_PROGRESS and the intent CREATED -> PENDING, and it is the only thing the runtime may call before contacting a provider. The callback no longer invents IN_PROGRESS; it settles only from IN_PROGRESS.
corrections.proved: iam_v2_scratch/phase4_0011_financial.sh asserts EXECUTING, then IN_PROGRESS, then ALREADY_EXECUTING on re-entry. Go integration TestIntegrationPayment_DarkNeverReachesTheProvider shows the boundary CROSSED and the provider still never reached: the intent is PENDING and the settlement IN_PROGRESS after three refused executions.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: A later callback carrying a DIFFERENT provider transaction reference for an already-pinned intent was silently discarded. Two provider transactions claiming one intent is an ambiguity about which money moved, and burying it in an applied event hides it permanently.
corrections.correction: 0016 makes provider_txn_ref write-once and raises PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_REF_CONFLICT BEFORE anything is recorded, so the conflict cannot be buried in an applied event.
corrections.proved: Go integration TestIntegrationPayment_CallbackCorrelationAndConflict asserts the typed provider_reference_conflict refusal.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: The 'unrelated settlements do not serialize' assertion ran after every other transaction had committed. With no lock held it proved nothing: of course an unrelated insert is fast when nothing is contended.
corrections.correction: The proof now opens a session that inserts a refund against a captured parent and HOLDS the parent advisory lock open for six seconds, asserts from pg_locks that the EXACT reconstructed ns_payment_parent key is granted to another backend, and only then has an independent session insert a charge on a different settlement.
corrections.proved: iam_v2_scratch/phase4_payment_concurrency.sh, 9 PASS / 0 FAIL, including 'the exact parent advisory key is genuinely held by the other session' and 'the unrelated settlement did not wait on the held parent lock'.

corrections.area: the one entitlement writer, on the current schema
corrections.what_was_actually_true: InsertEntitlement created an ACTIVE entitlement without recording its opening transition. Phase 3 requires an entitlement's status to be backed by its latest transition (the deferred p3_entitlement_status_coherent constraint), so on the CURRENT schema that writer could not commit at all. It was invisible because the Phase-2 suite only ever ran on the pre-0010 chain. No entitlement has ever been granted in Production from this path, so nothing live was affected.
corrections.correction: InsertEntitlement now records its opening ACTIVE transition through the same controlled apply_entitlement_transition every other state change uses, in the same transaction. One writer, one history, for both the free and the paid grant path.
corrections.proved: The Phase-2 free grant path (TestC2QuoteAndFreePurchase, TestC2ConcurrentSingleWinner, TestC4ImmutabilityAndPinTrigger) now runs against the FULL Phase-4 schema in scripts/phase4-pg-integration.sh, alongside the five paid-grant tests.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: The engine mapped every non-DARK guard refusal to UNKNOWN, so a refusal that provably never entered the adapter -- a missing adapter, an adapter that cannot correlate -- was recorded as money that may have moved.
corrections.correction: The guard refuses BEFORE delegating, so every error it returns is a pre-send refusal and is reported as NOT_SENT with nothing recorded. Only an adapter that was ENTERED and failed to answer becomes OutcomeUnknown.
corrections.proved: Go integration TestIntegrationPayment_UncorrelatableAdapterIsRefused asserts the typed config refusal rather than an UNKNOWN, and the settlement is left untouched.

corrections.what_was_actually_true: A callback with no evidence marshalled to a JSON null, which the append-only ledger correctly refuses -- so an ordinary provider notification carrying nothing to record could not be recorded at all.
corrections.correction: An absent evidence map is now an empty object. A callback with nothing to say is still a fact that must be written down.
corrections.proved: Go integration TestIntegrationPayment_DuplicateAndConcurrentCallbacksGrantOnce asserts exactly one new event row from eight concurrent duplicate deliveries.

delivered.payment_runtime: data-plane/internal/payment/: durable intent (CreateChargeIntent, CreateRefundIntent), the ordered Execute path (begin_payment_execution -> guard -> apply_payment_callback_v2 -> grant), ApplyCallback for out-of-band notifications, and a typed error vocabulary. Money fields are resolved from the pinned Purchase by the INSERT itself; the signatures accept no amount, currency, exponent, internal transaction id or provider result.
delivered.provider_boundary: A CAPABILITY CONTRACT, not a claim about any real provider. An adapter must carry StayConnect's client reference and return it on every notification; one that cannot is refused rather than allowed to guess. This build ships NO adapter: productionProvider returns a nilProvider and fails closed if provider execution is ever enabled without one. No real provider has been contacted, integrated or verified, and none is named as supported.
delivered.provider_doubles: Deterministic in-process only: ScriptedProvider (fixed outcome sequence, echoes the client reference back) and UncorrelatableProvider (must be refused). No networking exists anywhere in the package.
delivered.entitlement_handoff: internal/iamv2/commerce_settled_grant.go is a second ENTRY POINT into the existing Phase-2 writer, not a second writer: it calls the same TerminateLiveEntitlementForSubject / InsertEntitlement / MarkPurchaseGranted under the same subject lock inside the same WithTx. internal/payment/granter.go is the only Granter implementation and forwards without logic.
delivered.least_privilege: 0017 creates sc_payment_runtime, sc_financial_operator and sc_financial_readonly as real PostgreSQL roles with minimum grants, and re-asserts that PUBLIC holds EXECUTE on no SECURITY DEFINER function.

verification.financial_db_gate: 173 PASS / 0 FAIL (iam_v2_scratch/phase4_0011_financial.sh), including 0016 and 0017 UP / DOWN / re-UP with identical schema fingerprints
verification.payment_concurrency: 9 PASS / 0 FAIL, real concurrent PostgreSQL sessions with a genuinely held parent advisory lock
verification.least_privilege: 18 PASS / 0 FAIL as the real restricted roles (scripts/phase4-least-privilege.sh)
verification.entitlement_exactly_once: 5 PASS / 0 FAIL (IntegrationGrant), against the REAL CommerceEngine writing real entitlement rows
verification.unit: PASS across the whole data-plane module

not_delivered_in_this_milestone: No real provider adapter exists. The provider model is a capability contract this build cannot yet satisfy, and it fails closed rather than degrading.

The runtime DSN still connects as the schema owner. Switching the payment service to sc_payment_runtime additionally requires the entitlement grant to be reachable from a non-owner role; the roles are created, granted and proven at the database boundary, but the connection change is a deployment step deliberately not taken while DARK.

TestC2RollbackAtEveryBoundary is excluded from the shared-database step: it seeds a fixed device MAC and collides with itself when it shares a database. That is a pre-existing fixture defect in a test unrelated to the grant writer, and it still runs in its own Phase-2 harness.
Frontend, FINANCIAL_RECOVERY_MODE, observability, runtime PMS ownership integration, live-DARK deployment and reboot/rollback all remain outstanding.

migration_application.production: NOT APPLIED. 0010_phase3_stay_resolution remains the latest migration applied in Production.

timestamp_evidence: Recorded from the system clock in UTC after the verification matrix completed.
acceptance_verdict: NOT ACCEPTED and NOT CLOSED. Phase 4 remains IN_PROGRESS at DARK maturity. No cutover, no enablement, no deployment, no PR and no merge.
next_action: Build the WS-F Manual Review frontend and the WS-J operator payment surface, FINANCIAL_RECOVERY_MODE (WS-H) and observability (WS-I), then prepare the authorized controlled live-DARK deployment.
